body:
Founder real-time, live: 'gfd guest works BUT it says those require an SSH-bound identity, coming soon. it needs to say ssh in at okemily.com -p 2222 or something like that make it nice.' SSH has been live since Stage 4/5 (2026-09-12) but every guest-facing message still said 'coming soon.' New shared sshUpgradeHint constant used consistently across all 4 guest-facing messages (initial connect banner, economy-block, chat-block, requireSSHIdentity's key-management refusal). New regression test guards the exact wording never regresses to 'coming soon' again and always names the real command. Isolated from a concurrent in-flight main.go change via the established hunk-isolation technique, zero not-mine markers. go build/vet/test ./... clean. Live-verified on a throwaway instance, then rebuilt+redeployed to real production. GoblinFoxDragon commits cb63dc4 (source) + b732089 (binary redeploy).

⚓ ☃
title: Guest messaging: real SSH connect command replaces stale 'coming soon'
